title: A portable dry-run writes only to its own -dry-run roots: no archive, no source-manifest mirror
description: A --dry-run shared every output with a real build (stage root, archive names, tracked resources/cubric/update-manifest.json); on 2026-09-12 one overwrote the delivered 1.6.0 stage, both zips, and the tracked manifest (found on MPI-782).
